name: Mushroom Timers
description: Choose how long mushroom effects last: one percentage for all of them, or seconds for each mushroom. Set it in Configuration.
author: KSFA

options.label: Same for every mushroom
options.help: One percentage for every mushroom's effect.

options.label: Each mushroom on its own
options.help: A number of seconds for each mushroom.

settings.label: How long
settings.help: 100% is the game's own times. 200% makes every effect last twice as long; 50% half as long. This includes the mushrooms that hurt you when eaten (sleep, poison, confusion...).

settings.label: Thrown mushrooms too
settings.help: Also change how long a thrown mushroom's effect lasts on an enemy (sleep, poison, confusion, decoy, fire, smoke, dizziness), by the same amount.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_mushroom_efc SET tmmin = MAX(1, tmmin * {{percent}} / 100), tmmax = MAX(1, tmmax * {{percent}} / 100) WHERE tmmax > 0 AND (id IN (SELECT c_pefcid FROM master_mushroom UNION SELECT r_pefcid FROM master_mushroom) OR ({{thrown}} = 1 AND id IN (SELECT c_tefcid FROM master_mushroom UNION SELECT r_tefcid FROM master_mushroom)));
